title: bug: two overlapping wait_for_resource calls for one worker both park, because the existing-waiter check runs before an awaited runExclusive and the registration after it, and the first call's cleanup deletes the second call's registry entry, so disconnect cleanup and re-entry lose the live waiter
description:
Found by defect hunt #13 (task-cc441586). Line numbers are at HEAD f159784e.

PROBLEM (packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/waitForResource.ts)
- The "cancel the existing waiter" check (activeResourceWaiters.get, :74) runs BEFORE `await state.runExclusive(... acquireResource ...)` (:84). The registration (activeResourceWaiters.set) runs AFTER it (:175).
- A second call for the same worker that arrives inside that window sees no waiter yet. Its set at :175 then overwrites the first entry without cancelling the first call, so both RPCs stay parked.
- The first call's cleanup() later deletes the map entry unconditionally (:125), which removes the second, still-live waiter's entry.
- After that, the disconnect cleanup in server/WebSocketServer.ts (activeResourceWaiters.get(workerId)) and any re-entry can no longer find the parked second waiter. Its RPC and subscription live until its own timeout, at most 10 min.
- Siblings don't race:
  - wait_for_task has no await in that window.
  - chat_wait deletes only its own entry (tools/chatWait.ts:131, `...?.timer === this.timer`).

EVIDENCE
- Repro: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-cc441586/B/resourceWaiterReentry.test.ts. Copy it into packages/moe-daemon/src/__hunt__/ of a `git archive f159784e` snapshot.
- Command: `npx vitest run src/__hunt__/resourceWaiterReentry.test.ts`. Result: 1 failed. Verbatim:
```
t=300ms  registered: [ 'call1:worker-waiter', 'call2:worker-waiter' ] | first: "still parked" | second: "still parked"
t=1300ms first: {"granted":false,"timedOut":true,"resourceId":"box","position":1,...} | second: "still parked" | registry has worker-waiter: false
AssertionError: expected { Object (granted, timedOut, ...) } to deeply equal { granted: false, cancelled: true }
```
- Exposure: a guard gap, not a live incident. It needs two near-simultaneous waits for one worker id, for example an agent's parallel tool calls on two resources.

FIX DIRECTION
- Re-check for an existing waiter, and cancel it, right before activeResourceWaiters.set (:175), with no await in between.
- Make cleanup() delete the entry only while it is still this call's own, the chatWait identity guard.
- Don't touch server/WebSocketServer.ts: it is held at filing time, and the fix does not need it.

FILES: packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/waitForResource.ts, plus a new vitest file.
definitionOfDone: With two overlapping wait_for_resource calls for one worker, the earlier one resolves {granted:false, cancelled:true} once the later one registers, and activeResourceWaiters still holds the later waiter after the earlier call's cleanup runs.
A waiter's cleanup removes the registry entry only while that entry is still its own, so a disconnect cleanup finds and cancels the live waiter, in a new vitest file.
`npx vitest run` of the new file plus the existing waitForResource tests passes in a snapshot outside the shared checkout.
